description: A blind host-AI teacher estimate for one immutable public open-source pull request analyzed with the released EffortHours alpha.3 package.

source.notes: Immutable base tree 30ca1b4e412ebe5d59541bd1fdc29f8a2cb1ae27 and head tree 0e99f1b3078c446a009447ed2bf6da384ea28f18 retain LICENSE blob a828b2bd27ecea488ea8c4f5ebcbc7860235f98b. review.notes: Single disclosed host-AI teacher; no independent correction or adjudication. This is weak supervision, not actual labor, held-out accuracy, or production-readiness evidence.
